elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable, and the Deliverable definition includes specified work product created specifically for Customer.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: Vendor irrevocably assigns all right, title, and interest in each Deliverable to Customer upon creation.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property and Vendor Technology.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: No licence to Vendor IP or Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables is granted to Customer.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: No licence to embedded Vendor IP is granted, irrevocably or otherwise.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: No royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP is stated.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Customer Data is excluded from Vendor Technology, but the operative language does not affirmatively provide that Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: The evaluated language grants Vendor no licence in Customer Data, so the condition requiring a limitation on any such licence is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Customer exclusively owns Deliverables, while Vendor separately retains its pre-existing intellectual property and Vendor Technology; no joint ownership is created.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: Vendor retains Vendor Technology, which includes pre-existing tools, and Deliverables exclude generally applicable ideas, methods, skills, and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Customer receives exclusive ownership and all right, title, and interest upon creation without any term or reversion, which is broader than a perpetual licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Vendor expressly makes the assignment irrevocable, providing rights broader than an irrevocable licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The assignment covers all right, title, and interest without territorial limitation, which is broader than a worldwide licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Customer receives ownership upon creation without any stated royalty obligation, which is broader than a royalty-free licence.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Exclusive ownership and assignment of all rights permit Customer to use and modify Deliverables without a purpose restriction, including for its business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: As exclusive owner of all rights, Customer may grant downstream licences for its business, the ownership equivalent of sublicensing.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: The evaluated language grants Vendor no licence in Customer Data, so the condition requiring a limitation on any such licence is demonstrably absent.
